previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for an elective T3-4 and T6-7 transpedicular discectomy due to thoracic disc protrusions. Preoperatively, she received two units of platelets for mild thrombocytopenia. The surgery was performed successfully, and she tolerated it well, with stable neurological function postoperatively. On postoperative day two, she experienced a brief episode of hypoxemia, likely due to IV hydromorphone, which resolved after discontinuation. Her asthma, diabetes, and other comorbidities remained stable. She was discharged home with nursing and physical therapy support, ambulating at her baseline with a walker, and given detailed wound and medication instructions.
